map.载鱼量按增氧功率估算（精养每 kW 约支撑 700 kg/亩产量，半精养 450: The carrying capacity is estimated from aeration power (intensive supports about 700 kg/mu of yield per kW, semi-intensive 450 and extensive 200; when power is 0 this constraint is disabled and only the volume ceiling is used); a safety ceiling is also set by water volume (intensive 6, semi-intensive 3, extensive 1 kg/m³ of standing biomass; conversion: kg/m³ × depth × 666.67 = kg/mu). The recommended density takes the smaller of the two, and density = carrying capacity ÷ (size × survival rate).
map.池塘放养密度（本页代码口径）：单位增氧功率=总功率÷面积（kW/亩）；功率承载=: Pond stocking density (this page's implementation): aeration power per mu = total power ÷ area (kW/mu); power-based carrying capacity = power per mu × carrying capacity per kW (intensive 700, semi-intensive 450, extensive 200 kg/mu), used in the min() only when total power >0 (with power at 0 the natural-productivity basis is used); volume-based carrying capacity = standing biomass per m³ (intensive 6, semi-intensive 3, extensive 1 kg/m³) × area × depth × 666.67 ÷ area; standing biomass ceiling = the smaller of the two; stocking density = ceiling ÷ (market size g ÷ 1000) ÷ survival rate (individuals/mu); total seed = density × area rounded, total harvest = ceiling × area (kg). Validation: area, depth, target size and survival rate must be >0, power ≥0 and survival ≤100, otherwise the calculation stops with a prompt. Criteria (power per mu, kW/mu): ≥0.8 low risk, ≥0.5 medium risk, otherwise high risk, each with aeration and water-quality advice; without aeration a natural-productivity note is added.
map.默认参数：功率载鱼量 = (4/5)×450 = 360 kg/亩；水体载鱼量: With the default parameters: the power-based carrying capacity = (4/5)×450 = 360 kg/mu; the volume-based carrying capacity = 3×(5×1.2×666.67)/5 = 2400 kg/mu; take the smaller 360 kg/mu; stocking density = 360/(15/100)/0.75 ≈ 32000 shrimp/mu, a total stocking of ≈ 160000, with an expected yield of 1800 kg; aeration of 0.8 kW/mu reaches the low-risk line.
map.两者任一成为瓶颈都会限制产量，取小值保证不突破任一约束，是保守安全的设计。注意：: Either one becoming a bottleneck limits production; taking the smaller value ensures neither constraint is breached, a conservative and safe choice. Note: when power is 0 (e.g. an extensive reservoir) the power constraint is disabled and only the volume ceiling is used, with the source labelled "volume-based ceiling (no aeration)".
